scoring_justification: The binding energies and distances are DFT computed quantities; we cannot recompute them in the verifier. Result-level comparison against the paper's reported values with appropriate tolerances is the appropriate scoring method.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold reference binding energies and Cu-O distances for each system, as reported in Table 1 of the source paper
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: values are the paper-reported numbers, which are the target of reproduction

outputs.description: BSSE‑corrected Cu binding energies for the nine functionalized CNT+Cu complexes and the three bare CNT baselines. Lower (more negative) binding energies indicate stronger binding.

output_contract.notes: Binding energies are reported with a minus sign for exothermic binding. The hidden checker compares each value to reference values; meeting or exceeding (more negative) the reference earns full credit, and score decays only for weaker binding (less negative).
